intro: I'm Thomas Avice, a construction project manager in San Francisco. I also write software for the problems I run into on the job.
about: I've spent ten years on regulated projects in the Bay Area: schools, a hospital campus and historic renovation. I've worked in the field, in the office and in owner meetings.

Most of a PM's day goes into RFIs, submittals, change orders, cost reports and email, spread across Procore and a dozen inboxes. A lot of it is copy and paste. I build tools that pull that information into one place and use AI to write first drafts, which a person reviews before anything goes out.
I'm a licensed California general contractor (Class B) and have an M.S. in Civil Engineering & Engineering Project Management from UC Berkeley.
connect: If you're building software for construction, or you need someone who understands both the jobsite and the code, send me an email.
